name: Aivee WHITENING CRYSTAL MASK (5 Sheets)
description:
A Bio-Cellucose Mask made of naturally fermented coconut extract. The most advanced premium mask that seamlessly adheres to the face contours like second skin.

 

Indulge your skin with this luxurious whitening mask. Achieve skin luminosity and fairness with every use of Aivee Whitening Mask. Formulated with skin loving ingredients, the mask helps to strengthen skin barrier, locking moisture and active ingredients on your skin, giving you long lasting effects. Boost your skin’s natural radiance and improve skin imperfections. This mask is power-packed with Niacinamide, Alpha Arbutin, and Coconut Water which instantly brightens and energizes your skin, leaving a crystal-like glow after each use!

 

WHAT IS SO SPECIAL ABOUT OUR WHITENING CRYSTAL MASK?
brightens the skin’s overall complexion
improves pigmentation & suppresses melanin production
improves the appearance of dark spots
improves the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
plumps and gives skin a softer feel
improves the appearance of enlarged pores
 

DIRECTIONS: Before opening, gently distribute the serum evenly inside the sachet. Open the sachet, take out the mask and carefully unfold. Remove and discard the protective outer layers. Apply the Bio-Cellulose sheet onto the face, adjusting the openings over the eyes, nose and mouth. Gently smooth the mask over the entire face, eliminating any folds or air pockets. Leave the mask on for 15-20 minutes before removing. Gently massage any remaining serum into the skin. No rinsing necessary. Use as often as desired. Best used after cleansing and toning. Good for all skin types.

1 BOX CONTAINS 5 SHEETS
